# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.18

Prerelease snapshot of the working MCP with quality-candidate automation.

- Quality inventory: duplicate, possible dead-code and hardcoded-literal candidates.
- Root-reachability evidence and unreachable private groups; missing graph edges never prove dead code.
- Snapshot-bound candidate details, conservative TypeScript literal-extraction patches and persistent finding statuses.
- Background file-fact reuse and structured results in full/token-efficient MCP profiles.
- Explicit trusted project formatting, typechecks and tests on separate baseline/modified copies.
- Git-aware bounded monorepo snapshots, independent dependency copies and process-group timeouts.
- Repository configuration and fail-closed pre-apply agent guidance.
- Preserves the current working MCP's memory/resource management and compiler/graph integrations.

Automatic candidate patches remain a narrow TypeScript subset. Checks are review evidence, not proof of equivalence. Copy isolation is NOT an OS/network sandbox. Missing prerequisites, baseline failures or unsupported changes block automated application. No dependency installation or deployment commands run during verification.

Local contracts cover both response profiles, positive formatting/typecheck/tests, deliberate type/test failures, missing config, exact returned diff application, timeouts and cleanup. Remote CI results are reported separately.
